title: Afruz PXRD Analyzer
description: A Windows-focused Python and PySide6 workbench for powder X-ray diffraction import, preprocessing, peak analysis, Pawley and Le Bail whole-pattern extraction, Rietveld refinement, quantitative phase analysis, validation, doping-series comparison, reproducible export, and crystallographic visualization.
notes: Corresponding creator: Ali Afruz. Synthetic validation files are software-test fixtures, not certified reference materials. Users remain responsible for instrument calibration, model selection, and scientific interpretation.
